site.context: Kunteyi/Dayantan intercrystalline process brine (northern Qaidam Basin, Qinghai); not East Taijinar table brine; not a concession sample

meta.quality: Majors from Ren, Li, Zhang & Wu 2023 Frontiers in Environmental Science Table 1 sample 5 (Kunteyi intercrystalline brine). HCO3 0.15 g/L omitted (not in SUBSTANCES). B omitted (not in SUBSTANCES). Li+ not in that table — omitted (East Taijinar/Dongtai Li 141 mg/L in Murphy & Haji 2022 Table 1 is a different Qaidam lake, not this assay). Not a concession sample.
meta.notes: Ion masses converted from tabulated g/L (Br− from 16.98 mg/L) to g/kg with density 1.22 kg/L (screening hypersaline density — not a CTD; ISL East Taijinar table-brine density 1.21 is a different lake). mol_per_kg = g_per_kg / molarMassG from engine/model SUBSTANCES. Literature numbers are preferred over forcing charge balance. salinity_g_per_kg is the summed cited SUBSTANCES ions, not the 332.75 g/L TDS headline. Literature assay is not a mineral concession.
